about: What the title folder is made of, and for each part its licence, the licence texts that travel with it and where its source is.
tools/stage-notices.py reads this table after a build and writes licenses/ into the title folder: the texts, a
components.json that ties every executable file to the source revision it was built from, and a README.txt.
tools/check-notices.py verifies the result. Paths are relative to this repository; ${VULKAN} is ../PS5_Vulkan
(PS5_VULKAN_DIR), ${SDK_FORK} is ../PS5_PayloadSDK and ${LLVM} is .deps/llvm-project. A component is staged
when one of its 'artifacts' patterns matches a file in the title folder, or when 'always' is set.
'licence' is the licence the upstream project states for the part that ships; 'noncommercial' marks terms
that forbid commercial use, which the GPL does not allow a combined work to add (see the audit's counsel packet).
